Financing

Ways people pay for the build

Our financing team helps you pick a path and get it in place. These are the routes we work with.

  • Cash-out refinance

    Use equity you already have in the house.

  • HELOC

    A line of credit tied to the property’s value, drawn as the work needs it.

  • Renovation loan

    Money specifically for improving the property.

  • Personal loan

    Unsecured, when the terms are better than tapping the house.

We are not a lender and this is not financial advice. Terms depend on your lender and your situation.
